title: Criterion-Activated Preference Synthesis: Attribution-Preserving Preference Data from Explicit Standards
abstract: arXiv:2611.18663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is notoriously sensitive to attribution ambiguity: when chosen and rejected responses differ along multiple entangled dimensions, the model cannot identify which behavior the preference label teaches. We propose Criterion-Activated Preference Synthesis (CAPS), a criterion-first framework that turns explicit quality standards into attribution-verified preference pairs. CAPS synthesizes contexts and responses from a target criterion, then applies dual-signal scoring: a rubric-bound judge measures criterion compliance, while a blind general judge measures holistic quality. Two filters close the attribution loop: the Empirical Activation Test (EAT) keeps criterion-context pairs where satisfying the criterion improves blind quality, and the Attribution Ratio (AR) keeps pairs whose quality gap is dominated by the target criterion. Instantiated with general rubrics, medical rubrics, and Chinese legal statute

translated_title: 标准激活的偏好合成：从显式标准中生成保持归因的偏好数据
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）因归因歧义问题而广受诟病：当被选择与被拒绝的回复在多个相互纠缠的维度上存在差异时，模型无法识别偏好标签究竟在教哪种行为。我们提出了标准激活偏好合成（CAPS），这是一个“标准优先”的框架，能够将显式的质量标准转化为经过归因验证的偏好对。CAPS从目标标准出发合成上下文与回复，然后采用双信号评分机制：一个基于评分准则的裁判衡量标准符合度，而一个盲测的通用裁判衡量整体质量。两个过滤器完成了归因闭环：经验激活测试（EAT）保留那些“满足标准确实能提升盲测质量”的标准-上下文对，归因比率（AR）保留那些质量差距主要由目标标准主导的偏好对。该框架已在通用评分准则、医学评分准则和中文法律条文上进行了实例化验证。
tldr: CAPS提出一种标准优先的偏好数据合成框架，通过双信号评分和EAT、AR两道过滤器，从显式质量标准生成归因清晰、可验证的偏好对，从而解决DPO中因多维差异纠缠导致的归因歧义问题。
en_tdlr: CAPS is a criterion-first framework that converts explicit quality standards into attribution-verified preference pairs via dual-signal scoring and two filters (EAT and AR), resolving the attribution ambiguity that undermines DPO training.
